prompt: Which graphs are among the metric graphs shown on a Redis Cloud database's Metrics screen? (Select three.)
explanation: The database Metrics screen graphs operations and latency (Ops/sec, reads/sec, writes/sec, other commands), used memory, total keys, connections, evicted and expired objects per second, hit ratio, and network ingress and egress bytes per second. Host-level figures such as CPU temperature and abstract application-side metrics like a connection-pool eviction rate are not among these graphs.
